name: Pin your own binary question in the first minute
template: Post the first comment yourself, a two-option question that extends the premise, and pin it
examples: Okay but what's worse? Gym crush or work crush?? 😩
Be honest: text back in 2 minutes or 2 days?
mechanism: Gives every viewer a zero-effort comment; the pinned thread becomes the conversation hub, and reply count on a pinned comment is engagement on the Reel.
anti_pattern: 'Comment YES', 'tag a friend', 'like if' — engagement bait is deprioritized.
observed: Pinned question on a 1.9M Reel: 71 likes, 14 direct replies, and seeded threads with 40+ replies

name: Reply inside the top thread, in character
template: Within the first hour, reply to the 2–3 highest-liked comments with one in-character line; do not thank people
examples: (to '0.0001% of men are 6'5') — that's why I said it
(to 'why'd my boyfriend like this') — ask him
mechanism: Replies keep the top threads alive (each reply re-surfaces the thread), and the in-character voice extends the bit instead of breaking it.
anti_pattern: 'Thank you so much!!' on every comment; replying to hostile comments at all.
observed: The creator with the best views-to-followers ratio replies inside threads; the two larger accounts don't

name: Let the audience quote the bit
template: Write at least one line in the Reel that is short enough to be typed from memory — that line becomes the top comment
examples: 'Steak is too lobstery… juice is full of butter' (46K likes as a comment)
'I guess I'll stay for one more year…' (25K likes)
mechanism: A quotable line turns comments into a highlight reel of the video and turns comments into sends ('hello why'd my boyfriend like this').
anti_pattern: Lines that only work with the face/timing; no single sentence a viewer can carry.
observed: Top comment on the 5.3M Reel is a quote from the Reel

name: Don't answer hostile comments; answer the admiring one next to it
template: Never reply to 'influencer'/'cringe'/'sponsored' comments; reply to the admiring comment directly below it so the thread ordering favours the tone you want
examples: (skip 'Instagram vs reality lol'; reply to 'take me back' with 'same')
mechanism: Replies boost threads; boosting a hostile thread pins it under your Reel. Answering the neighbour instead raises the healthier thread.
anti_pattern: Arguing; deleting comments in bulk (drops comment count).
observed: Visual-only account: zero creator replies, comment section is emoji noise; niche-community accounts: hostile threads rise when answered
